Piquant General Shaman (Korean: ) is Scallion Kimchi Cookie's first Costume, released in the first half of Return to Yakgwa Village: Haunting Tales update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Behold the shaman, channeling the energies of the Great Fish Sauce General, Salt General, and Chili Pepper General! So infamous are here exorcisms that the malicious spirits go running as soon as word gets around she's preparing for another ritual. Her blades are as merciless as the kimchi brine that drips off their edges, and the evil intentions may want to change their minds!

Trivia

  • Piquant General Shaman was released alongside  Jakdu Headbutt,  Yakgwa Village Envoy, and  Cinematic Songster.
